name: Shallorn
look: a round brown shallot with droopy green leaves like hair, closed forlorn eyes, a drooping orange root moustache and a stalk with a green flower-bud
entry: It has stopped crying and grown gloomy instead, drooping its leaves over its face and sighing into its moustache. The faint stink around it keeps everyone at a polite distance.
how: Evolve Tearion at level 18. It learns Sludge when it evolves.
Wild: uncommon in plains, grasslands, forests and swamps.
